sentences.en: Now, obviously, like I said at the beginning, people might be watching this for a variety of reasons.
sentences.zh: 现在，很显然，正如我一开始所说的那样，人们观看这个视频的原因可能有很多种。

sentences.en: And one of those reasons might be that someone is going to be undergoing a Waste 5 themselves.
sentences.zh: 其中一个原因可能是某些人自己就要接受WAIS-5测试。

sentences.en: They might be a bit disappointed by that answer that we've just given because they might be like, but I wanted to do really well.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会对我们刚刚给出的回答感到有点失望，因为他们可能会想：可是我很想表现得非常好啊。

sentences.en: Or, you know, why is that a problem then that we're not giving away all these secrets?
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道的，为什么我们不透露所有这些秘密反倒是个问题呢？

sentences.en: Why can't we help these people to do as well as they can?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不能帮助这些人尽可能发挥出最好水平呢？

sentences.en: There's a really interesting psychological phenomenon known as a practice effect.
sentences.zh: 有一个非常有趣的心理学现象被称为“练习效应”。

sentences.en: So the more we practice something, the better our score will be.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，我们对某事练习得越多，我们的得分就会越高。

sentences.en: But that is just from practice rather than necessarily reflecting our underlying ability.
sentences.zh: 但那仅仅是来自于练习，并不一定能反映出我们潜在的基本能力。

sentences.en: So an interesting real life example is often families have youngsters who are doing an 11 plus test to see whether they can get into the local grammar school.
sentences.zh: 一个有趣的现实生活例子是，许多家庭会让孩子参加“11岁升学考试”（11 plus），看看他们能否进入当地的文法学校。

sentences.en: And if you get your youngster to practice the 11 plus tests, you will actually give them an advantage in that they will score better than if they hadn't practiced.
sentences.zh: 如果你让孩子练习11岁升学考试的题目，实际上确实会赋予他们优势，他们会比没有练习过的人考得更好。

sentences.en: And that may be the difference between them getting in or not getting in to their local grammar school.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是他们能否考入当地文法学校的区别所在。

sentences.en: But of course, if they then are offered that place, when it comes down to actually doing the work that is, you know, being required,
sentences.zh: 但当然，如果他们随后获得了入学资格，当真正需要去完成那些要求的学业时，

sentences.en: sometimes that can feel like a very steep learning curve and people can feel like they are outside their comfortable levels of ability.
sentences.zh: 有时这会让他们觉得是一个非常陡峭的学习曲线，人们会觉得自己超出了舒适的能力范围。

sentences.en: And I guess that's why this matters, because we want to get a genuine snapshot, a genuine overview of this person's presentation and of their strengths and limitations.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么这很重要，因为我们希望获得一个真实的快照、一个关于此人表现以及其优势与局限性的真实概述。

sentences.en: And if you are feeling really anxious about going to the test,
sentences.zh: 如果你对去参加测试感到非常焦虑，

sentences.en: please just tell your clinician and they can help you work through that without you needing to to kind of to practice, practice,
sentences.zh: 请务必告诉你的临床医生，他们可以帮你克服这种情绪，而无需你去没完没了地练习、练习、再练习，

sentences.en: practice and to make sure that nothing's going to catch you off guard.
sentences.zh: 去确保没有任何事情会打你个措手不及。

sentences.en: Because actually, whilst it might sound a little bit unsettling, partly what we want to do is to have these novel tests, not to catch you out, but to help us understand you better.
sentences.zh: 因为事实上，虽然这听起来可能有点让人不安，但我们部分的目的就是采用这些新颖的测试，不是为了难倒你，而是为了更好地理解你。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think sometimes it's worth saying to someone that there is no good or bad result from this assessment.
sentences.zh: 对，我认为有时值得对受试者说的是，这次评估没有所谓的好或坏的结果。

sentences.en: It just offers a quantification of ability across different areas, which is helpful in understanding your strengths,
sentences.zh: 它只是对各个不同领域的能力进行了量化，这对于了解你的优势、

sentences.en: your relative weaknesses or understanding what's happened to your thinking ability due to an accident or injury.
sentences.zh: 你的相对弱点，或者了解由于意外或伤害而对你的思维能力造成了什么影响大有帮助。

sentences.en: But there's no good or bad result.
sentences.zh: 但并没有什么好或坏的结果。

sentences.en: And again, going back to our thinking about intelligence and intelligence theories, the value of a person is not in their IQ or intelligence.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，回到我们对智力和智力理论的思考上，一个人的价值并不在于他的智商或智力。

sentences.en: Now, that was the mistake made in the 1930s with the eugenics movement and using IQ as a reason for seeing some people as good and some people as bad.
sentences.zh: 那正是20世纪30年代优生学运动所犯的错误，他们将智商作为将某些人视为优等、将某些人视为劣等的借口。

sentences.en: We've grown beyond that, thank heavens.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，我们已经超越了那个时代。

sentences.en: And there is no good or bad result from a waste five.
sentences.zh: 韦氏第五版测试并没有什么好或坏的结果。

sentences.en: Yeah, really, really important.
sentences.zh: 对，真的，真的很重要。

sentences.en: Thank you, Keith.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，基思。

sentences.en: OK, let's have another look at a quick fire round, Keith.
sentences.zh: 好的，基思，我们来快速过一下另一个环节。

sentences.en: What's the biggest misconception that people have about IQ scores?
sentences.zh: 人们对智商分数最大的误解是什么？

sentences.en: Probably that the higher IQ, the more successful and rich and famous you're going to be, because ability in real life is about a bit more than your IQ score.
sentences.zh: 可能在于认为智商越高，你就会越成功、越富有、越出名，因为现实生活中的能力并不完全取决于你的智商分数。

sentences.en: And it's about a bit more than maybe how you might perform on a standardized measure like the waste five.
sentences.zh: 而且它也不仅仅取决于你在标准化测量（比如韦氏智力量表第五版）中的表现。

sentences.en: And the best example is we think about Albert Einstein, probably most people would agree, wow, he's a genius and came up with some fantastic ideas.
sentences.zh: 最好的例子就是阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦，大多数人可能会赞同，哇，他是个天才，提出了许多了不起的想法。

sentences.en: But actually, Albert Einstein also had dyslexia.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦也患有阅读障碍。

sentences.en: We spoke earlier about dyslexia being shown by, you know, performance on some of the waste five subjects won't necessarily be that great.
sentences.zh: 我们之前谈到过，阅读障碍可以从韦氏五版某些测验项目中的表现看出来，这些表现不一定很理想。

sentences.en: So Albert Einstein may not have got a great overall score on an intelligence test or even on the waste five, yet we'd all agree he was a genius.
sentences.zh: 所以，阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦在智力测验甚至韦氏五版的整体得分上可能并不高，但我们都会承认他是个天才。

sentences.en: And then the earlier example, you know, somebody that can survive in the Kalahari Desert.
sentences.zh: 还有之前那个例子，你知道的，一个能够在卡拉哈里沙漠生存下来的人。

sentences.en: Well, I think he's pretty smart, but actually on the waste five or any similar tests may get really bad scores.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得他相当聪明，但在韦氏五版或任何类似测试中，得分可能会非常糟糕。

sentences.en: So that's the misconception.
sentences.zh: 这就是误解所在。

sentences.en: High IQ doesn't necessarily mean high success or high survivability.
sentences.zh: 高智商并不一定意味着高度成功或高生存能力。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So important.
sentences.zh: 太重要了。

sentences.en: So does a high IQ mean someone is going to thrive?
sentences.zh: 那么，高智商是否意味着一个人一定会过得很好、有所成就呢？

sentences.en: It doesn't necessarily, because there are so many other factors within our society that determine whether somebody thrives or not.
sentences.zh: 不一定，因为我们社会中还有许多其他因素决定着一个人能否蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: You may be from a marginalised minority group, you may have a fantastic IQ, but because of the group that you're from, you may suffer a range of adversities in ordinary life.
sentences.zh: 你可能来自被边缘化的少数群体，你的智商可能极高，但由于你的出身背景，你在现实生活中可能会遭遇各种逆境。

sentences.en: You may even be an incredibly intelligent woman, but choose to go into a career where there is prejudice or a lack of culture that embraces incredibly bright women.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能是一位极其聪明的女性，但选择了一个充满偏见、或者缺乏包容极具才华女性文化的职业领域。

sentences.en: So no, sadly, we know that thriving in our society is about far more than just your IQ.
sentences.zh: 所以，遗憾的是，我们知道在社会中取得成功远不仅仅取决于智商。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And often if we're working with someone from a complex trauma background, someone might be incredibly bright and able, but just kind of socially,
sentences.zh: 通常如果我们与有复杂创伤背景的人合作，某人可能极其聪明能干，但只是在社交方面、

sentences.en: demographically and all of the kind of, sometimes it takes money to do really well as well.
sentences.zh: 人口统计学上，以及各种层面上——有时候要取得巨大的成功也需要资金。

sentences.en: And if you've got less of that, sometimes it's just less opportunities to do what society would think of as thriving.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这方面较少，有时就只是缺乏社会所认为的“成功”的机会。

sentences.en: Yeah, and that's a really good point.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常好的观点。

sentences.en: And I suppose kind of cycles back to this idea around selection or measurement in education.
sentences.zh: 我想这也回到了教育中关于选拔或测量的这个理念。

sentences.en: If we had a culture fair or free way of identifying really bright young people, regardless of their background,
sentences.zh: 如果我们有一种文化公平或无偏见的方式来识别真正聪明的年轻人，而不论他们的背景如何，

sentences.en: so that they could actually receive the educational support that could allow them to really achieve that would make a wonderful contribution to our society.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就能真正获得能够让他们大有所成的教育支持，这将对我们的社会做出巨大的贡献。

sentences.en: But it's finding those ways that are as culture fair and culture free as possible.
sentences.zh: 但难点在于找到那些尽可能做到文化公平和文化无偏见的方法。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，完全同意。

sentences.en: You've kind of led us really nicely into then thinking about the future.
sentences.zh: 你很自然地引导我们开始思考未来。

sentences.en: What do you think the future of kind of adult intelligence testing looks like?
sentences.zh: 你认为未来成年人智力测验会是什么样子的？

sentences.en: Gosh, that's a massive question, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 天哪，这是一个极其宏大的问题，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's kind of almost into science fiction territory, aren't we, in terms of thinking about what might be coming along that will be much brighter and smarter than us psychologists,
sentences.zh: 我们在思考未来可能会出现比我们这些心理学家聪明得多、厉害得多的东西时，几乎已经进入了科幻小说的领域，

sentences.en: and even our really cutting edge tests like the waste five we have at the moment,
sentences.zh: 甚至超越了我们目前拥有的像韦氏五版这样最尖端的测试，

sentences.en: maybe AI will bring the ability to have a tool that can look at so many more aspects of the individual that we're assessing simultaneously,
sentences.zh: 也许人工智能将带来这样一种工具：它能够同时观察我们所评估的个体的更多方面，

sentences.en: in order to say something more valuable about their ability to cope in day to day life or say something more valuable about the difficulties they've acquired due to an injury and ways in which they may be better compensated for by using the abilities that are still retained.
sentences.zh: 从而对他们应对日常生活的能力做出更有价值的评估，或者对他们因受伤而产生的不便以及如何通过充分利用仍保留的能力来进行更好的代偿，做出更有价值的评估。

sentences.en: Yeah, okay.
sentences.zh: 好的，明白了。

sentences.en: And obviously, I'm aware that many of us are weaving AI into our own lives.
sentences.zh: 显然，我注意到我们许多人都在将人工智能融入自己的生活。

sentences.en: How do you think that is impacting on our capability on our abilities on our on our IQ?
sentences.zh: 你认为这会对我们的能力、我们的才智以及我们的智商产生什么影响？

sentences.en: Well, scarily, it may be making our IQs a little bit worse.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有些可怕的是，它可能会让我们的智商变得稍微退步一点。

sentences.en: So if we think about something that's been known about by psychologists for several decades, the so called Flynn effect, based upon the researcher that first identified it.
sentences.zh: 如果我们回想一下心理学家几十年来已知的一个现象，也就是所谓的弗林效应，它是以最初发现该现象的研究人员命名的。

sentences.en: So for quite a long time, IQ was rising.
sentences.zh: 在相当长的一段时间里，智商一直在上升。

sentences.en: So year on year measurement of kind of average IQ showed that it was actually rising over time.
sentences.zh: 因此，年复一年的平均智商测量显示，随着时间的推移，智商实际上在不断上升。

sentences.en: But since the mid 1990s, overall IQ appears to be falling by, you know, maybe two or three IQ points each year.
sentences.zh: 但自20世纪90年代中期以来，总体智商似乎在下降，每年大约下降两到三个智商点。

sentences.en: And this is based upon the fact probably that we aren't exercising our brains and those components of intelligence quite as much as we used to,
sentences.zh: 这可能是因为我们不像过去那样经常锻炼我们的大脑和智力的那些组成部分了，

sentences.en: because we're relying upon AI and other systems to do things for us.
sentences.zh: 因为我们过分依赖人工智能和其他系统来替我们做事。

sentences.en: So there's an interesting balance to be found and to be still achieved between using technology to support us in tasks and actually continuing to use our mental faculty to do tasks.
sentences.zh: 因此，在利用技术协助我们完成任务与继续运用我们自身的智力去完成任务之间，需要找到并实现一个有趣的平衡。

sentences.en: Because reliance upon external devices and aids may mean that when one day they break down, we then struggle to be able to, for example,
sentences.zh: 因为对外部设备和辅助工具的依赖可能意味着，一旦有一天它们发生故障，我们将难以，例如，

sentences.en: take a pencil and paper and do some calculations.
sentences.zh: 拿起纸笔来进行一些计算。

sentences.en: So, yeah,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，

sentences.en: really interesting times and interesting questions for us to ask ourselves and to ask our society about how much we do use the wonders of AI and making life easy for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的时代，也给我们自己和我们的社会提出了有趣的问题：我们在多大程度上利用人工智能的奇迹来让生活变得轻松，

sentences.en: What the cost is in doing that and the dependence that develops upon those devices and aids.
sentences.zh: 而这样做的代价是什么，以及对这些设备和辅助工具产生了怎样的依赖。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That really is something to consider, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这确实是值得深思的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: So before we finish, let's let's just have a little look at how the WACE-5 is kind of clinically useful and helpful as a tool for clinicians.
sentences.zh: 所以在我们结束之前，让我们简单来看看韦氏五版作为临床医生的工具是如何在临床上发挥作用和提供帮助的。

sentences.en: What would you say, Keith?
sentences.zh: 基思，你觉得呢？

sentences.en: I think I'd say that the WACE-5 is another step change in the Wechsler history of tests.
sentences.zh: 我想说，韦氏五版是韦氏智力测验历史上的又一次跨越式发展。

sentences.en: I mean, it really is learning from experience and learning from increasing depth of knowledge about components of intellectual function.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它确实是在汲取经验，并随着对智力功能组成部分认知深度的增加而不断学习。

sentences.en: So it brings in new sub tests to enable us to look better at someone's abilities.
sentences.zh: 因此，它引入了新的分测验，使我们能够更好地了解某人的能力。

sentences.en: It also brings in for people where we think or where it's clear that they do have a degree of intellectual ability or giftedness and introduces new ways of starting the sub tests that take account of the fact that someone can maybe start further on in that particular sub teSt.
sentences.zh: 对于那些我们认为或明显具有一定智力能力或天赋的人，它还引入了开始分测验的新方法，考虑到了某人可能从该特定分测验的更后面部分开始的可能性。

sentences.en: Therefore, making the assessment faster for people that do come along with clearly some gifts or ability.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于那些显然具有某些天赋或能力的人来说，评估变得更快了。

sentences.en: So I think it's learning from experience in how to make administration faster where that's possible and how to make assessment deeper in terms of those components of intellectual function.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这是在吸取经验，学习如何在可能的情况下加快施测速度，以及如何在智力功能的这些组成部分方面使评估更加深入。

sentences.en: So I think the WACE-5 takes us on another journey of, yes, as clinicians, we've got to learn how to do some new things.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为韦氏五版带我们踏上了另一段旅程：是的，作为临床医生，我们必须学习如何做一些新事情。

sentences.en: But as clinicians, if we learn that, we'll actually be having an assessment that gives us a much richer picture that we can use in understanding the person before us.
sentences.zh: 但作为临床医生，如果我们学会了这些，我们实际上将获得一份评估报告，它能为我们提供一幅更丰富的全景图，帮助我们理解面前的这个人。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And I guess with that in mind, if people do want to get hold of a WACE-5, so the WESHLA Adult Intelligence Scale version 5,
sentences.zh: 我想顺便说一句，如果人们想要获取韦氏五版，也就是韦氏成人智力量表第五版，

sentences.en: the details are in the description and in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 详细信息在说明栏和节目备注中。

sentences.zh: 感谢培生集团与我和基思合作制作了这个非常有帮助的节目。

sentences.zh: 我真的非常非常享受。

sentences.zh: 所以感谢你的时间。

sentences.zh: 本期节目是如何帮助你加深对成人智力测验的理解的。

sentences.zh: 基思，再次感谢你的时间。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你，玛伦。
